title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
abstract: arXiv:2611.17806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly serve as persistent personal assistants across modern web platforms, managing schedules, applications, and multi-step plans over weeks or months. Users often return to an ongoing conversation after a long conversational hiatus, while earlier bookings and preparation notes stay on record. During this hiatus, scheduled dates may pass even though the retained records remain unchanged and event outcomes go unrecorded. Existing evaluations of long-horizon agents focus on fact retention and explicit state updates. Whether agents perceive the passage of time and adapt their advice accordingly therefore remains unknown. We frame this ability as temporal state perception and use, which means perceiving the current time and applying it when interpreting dated records. translated_title: 智能体能跟上时间吗？对话中断后时间适应性调整的实证分析
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体日益在现代网络平台上充当持久化的个人助理，在数周或数月的跨度内管理日程、申请和多步骤计划。用户常常在长时间的对话中断后回到先前的对话中，而此前的预订记录和准备笔记仍保留在案。在这种中断期间，即使保留的记录没有任何变化、事件结果也未被记录，预定的日期也可能已经过去。现有对长时程智能体的评估主要聚焦于事实记忆和显式状态更新，因此智能体是否能感知时间的流逝并相应调整其建议，仍属未知。我们将这种能力定义为时间状态感知与运用，即感知当前时间，并在解读带有日期的记录时加以运用。为研究这一能力，我们设计了“会话重燃”任务：保持先前的对话固定不变，仅改变后续跟进的日期以及时间信息的呈现方式……
tldr: 本文提出“时间状态感知与运用”这一新能力概念，通过设计会话重燃任务（固定先前对话、仅变化后续日期），实证考察长时程智能体在对话中断后能否感知时间流逝并据此调整建议，填补了现有评估只关注事实记忆与显式状态更新的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of "temporal state perception and use" and empirically examines—via session-rekindling tasks that hold the prior conversation fixed while varying only the follow-up date—whether long-horizon agents can perceive the passage of time after a conversational hiatus and adapt their advice accordingly, a capability overlooked by existing evaluations focused on fact retention and explicit state updates.
